item.title: The BEAM Is a Friendly Host: C, Rust, Svelte and WebGPU Next to Elixir
item.author: lalabuy9948@gmail.com (Daniil Popov)
item.description:
A few weeks ago I wrote down my CyanCamera talk. This is my second talk of the year, from Goatmire, this time for an Elixir crowd.

Short version: we had a small LiveView dashboard on a camera control panel. It grew into a desktop color studio. Every time things got harder we put another language next to Elixir, and we never rewrote anything.

item.title: CyanCamera: Turning an iPhone Into a Broadcast Camera
item.author: lalabuy9948@gmail.com (Daniil Popov)
item.description: This year I gave a 20 minute talk at RTCON by Software Mansion about the color science behind CyanCamera. It’s the app we built at CyanView so an iPhone can stand next to a Sony Venice or an ARRI Alexa in a live broadcast truck. Here is the talk, written down and a bit shorter.
